name: Candelabra
note: Candelabra: Make the teal backdrop a brighter, more saturated teal with a soft light glow behind the candelabra and slightly darker corners. Paint the brass as smooth warm gold with a few broad, soft highlights in place of the many small sharp reflections, and a gently darker right side. Keep the candelabra, the candles, the flames, the soft floor shadow and the view.

name: Parasol
note: Parasol: Simplify the lace trim into a smooth, soft cream scalloped band with no punched holes. Paint the canopy as smooth, soft matte fabric with no visible weave. Keep the parasol, the ribs, the handle, the yellow diamond backdrop and the view.

name: Folding Fan
note: Folding Fan: Paint the pleats a slightly deeper rose pink, lit from the upper left, with a bright face and a darker face on each pleat and the right half gently darker. Replace the realistic lace with a smooth, soft cream scalloped band made of a few broad shapes. Add a soft shadow of the fan down and to the right on a slightly deeper blue wave backdrop. Keep the fan, the sticks, the gold pin and the view.

name: Cake Stand
note: Cake stand: Paint the tablecloth a soft mid-tone rose, clearly darker than the cream stand, and make the purple wall a slightly lighter violet with a soft glow behind the stand. Give the porcelain crisp glossy highlights on the plate rims and the knob, with slightly darker plate undersides and a darker right side on the column. Keep the stand, the cakes, the striped wall and the view.
